sections.text:
[Effects]
Reduces physical damage taken by XL.
Damage reduction scales with the number of Armor type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When physical damage is taken.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Armor type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of L+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
